title: The Well at Pell
story: In the village of Pell, a round well kept coins that were offered for someone else and returned coins that were offered for oneself. Tessa dropped in a coin and wished for a new coat. The coin landed back on the moss beside her shoe. She tried again, wishing for her brother's exam to go calmly, and that coin stayed in the dark water. Tessa sat on the wall and laughed at her own first attempt. She told her brother only that the well was particular. On the exam morning she left another coin for his steady hands. The well made no sound, which, in Pell, counted as a yes.

vocabulary.definition: Given for a purpose, here with a wish.
A soft green plant that grows in damp places.
Hard to please, and accepting only certain things.

quiz.question: What happened to the coin Tessa wished on for a coat?
options: It landed back on the moss beside her shoe
It stayed deep in the water
Her brother caught it before it fell
It turned into a second coin
quiz.correctAnswer: It landed back on the moss beside her shoe
quiz.explanation: After she wished for a new coat, the coin landed back on the moss beside her shoe.
quiz.supportingSentence: The coin landed back on the moss beside her shoe.

quiz.question: Why does Tessa laugh at her first attempt?
options: The exam had already been cancelled
She sees that a wish for herself was the wrong kind
Every coin in the village came back at the same moment
Her brother had bought the coat already
quiz.correctAnswer: She sees that a wish for herself was the wrong kind
quiz.explanation: The well returns wishes made for oneself, and she laughs at that first attempt once she has understood.
quiz.supportingSentence: Tessa sat on the wall and laughed at her own first attempt.

quiz.question: What happened to the coin for her brother's exam?
options: It bounced back onto the wall
It paid for a new coat
It stayed in the dark water
It was returned the same afternoon
quiz.correctAnswer: It stayed in the dark water
quiz.explanation: When she wished for her brother's exam to go calmly, that coin stayed in the dark water.
quiz.supportingSentence: She tried again, wishing for her brother's exam to go calmly, and that coin stayed in the dark water.

quiz.question: What does the limited thing she told her brother suggest?
options: She refused to speak to him at all
She described every returned coin in detail
She said the well had cracked and dried
She kept the well's full rule to herself
quiz.correctAnswer: She kept the well's full rule to herself
quiz.explanation: She tells him only that the well is particular, so she withholds the rest of what she has learned.
quiz.supportingSentence: She told her brother only that the well was particular.

quiz.question: What does particular mean in this story?
options: Broken, and unable to hold water
Accepting only certain kinds of wishes
Loud enough for the whole village to hear
Willing to grant any wish at all
quiz.correctAnswer: Accepting only certain kinds of wishes
quiz.explanation: Tessa calls the well particular because it keeps some offerings and sends others back.
quiz.supportingSentence: She told her brother only that the well was particular.
